en.title: Ball Bounce! Car Go! 🏀🚗 | Toy Song for Toddlers | Momo Time
en.description:
Bounce with a ball and roll a toy car with Momo! A cheerful English sing-along for toddlers ages 2–4.

Learn two easy words: BALL and CAR.
Sing the short repeating chorus, copy the sounds and clap along.

#MomoTime #BallAndCar #ToySong #ToddlerSongs #NurseryRhymes #KidsSongs #PreschoolSongs #SingAlong
